title: Bounded work-head reachability
statement: For a Boolean input string $y$, a natural number $W$, and configurations $c,c'$ of the one-work-tape machine on input $y$, there is a time $T$ such that running the program from $c$ for $T$ steps reaches $c'$, and at every earlier time $t<T$ the work-head position lies between $-1$ and $W$, inclusive.
hypotheses_covered: existence of a run length $T$ reaching $c'$
work-head position between $-1$ and $W$ at every time $t<T$
